797: def flush(timeout_millis: int = 30000) -> bool:
798:     """Flush the process-default Neatlogs pipeline only."""
799:     global _tracer_provider
800:     success = True
801: 
802:     # Log provider must flush BEFORE tracer provider: the tracer batch includes
803:     # the neatlogs.trace.complete marker which triggers server-side finalization.
804:     # Flushing logs first guarantees LOG records reach ClickHouse before the
805:     # completion marker fires the trace-finalizer query.
806:     if _log_provider:
807:         try:
808:             logger.debug("Flushing log provider...")
809:             _log_provider.force_flush(timeout_millis=timeout_millis)
810:             logger.debug("Log provider flushed successfully")
811:         except Exception as e:
812:             logger.error(f"Error flushing logs: {e}", exc_info=True)
813:             success = False
814: 
815:     for processor in _transport_span_processors:
816:         try:
817:             logger.debug("Flushing Neatlogs trace processor...")
818:             ok = processor.force_flush(timeout_millis=timeout_millis)
819:             success = (ok is None or bool(ok)) and success
820:         except Exception as e:
821:             logger.error(f"Error flushing spans: {e}", exc_info=True)
822:             success = False
823: 
824:     # A root is accepted only at the final post-mask export boundary. That
825:     # acceptance queues its completion marker, so drain the trace batch once
826:     # more to include the newly queued marker in this flush contract.
827:     if _transport_span_processors:
828:         try:
829:             ok = _transport_span_processors[0].force_flush(timeout_millis=timeout_millis)
830:             success = (ok is None or bool(ok)) and success
831:         except Exception as e:
832:             logger.error(f"Error flushing completion markers: {e}", exc_info=True)
833:             success = False
834: 
835:     return success

849: def flush_all(timeout_millis: int = 30000) -> Dict[str, bool]:
850:     """Flush every live Neatlogs pipeline concurrently under one deadline.
851: 
852:     Only processors/exporters installed by Neatlogs are flushed. The process-global
853:     OpenTelemetry provider and caller/foreign processors are never touched.
854:     """
855:     from .core.client_registry import snapshot_clients
856: 
857:     clients = snapshot_clients()
858:     operations = [("default", flush)] if _initialized else []
859:     operations.extend(
860:         (f"client:{client.workflow_name}:{id(client):x}", client.flush) for client in clients
861:     )
862:     if not operations:
863:         return {}
864: 
865:     results: Dict[str, bool] = {name: False for name, _ in operations}
866:     timeout_seconds = max(0, timeout_millis) / 1000
867:     deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_seconds
868:     completed: queue.Queue[tuple[str, bool]] = queue.Queue()
869: 
870:     def run(name: str, operation: Callable[[int], bool]) -> None:
871:         try:
872:             completed.put((name, bool(operation(timeout_millis))))
873:         except BaseException:
874:             completed.put((name, False))
875: 
876:     if timeout_seconds <= 0:
877:         return results
878:     for name, operation in operations:
879:         threading.Thread(
880:             target=run,
881:             args=(name, operation),
882:             name="neatlogs-flush",
883:             daemon=True,
884:         ).start()
885: 
886:     remaining = len(operations)
887:     while remaining and time.monotonic() < deadline:
888:         try:
889:             name, success = completed.get(timeout=max(0.001, deadline - time.monotonic()))
890:         except queue.Empty:
891:             break
892:         results[name] = success
893:         remaining -= 1
894:     return results

908: def shutdown(
909:     timeout_millis: int = 30000,
910:     termination_reason: str = "shutdown",
911:     *,
912:     _synchronous: bool = False,
913: ) -> bool:
914:     """Run one shutdown at a time and make same-thread re-entry non-blocking."""
915:     global _shutdown_state, _shutdown_owner, _shutdown_result, _shutdown_worker
916:     deadline = time.monotonic() + max(0, timeout_millis) / 1000
917:     current_thread = threading.get_ident()
918:     with _shutdown_condition:
919:         if _shutdown_worker is None:
920:             if _synchronous:
921:                 return False
922:             _shutdown_worker = DeadlineWorker("neatlogs-default-shutdown")
923:         if _shutdown_state == "closing":
924:             # end_active_spans() invokes processors synchronously. If one of
925:             # those callbacks re-enters shutdown on this thread, waiting here
926:             # would deadlock the original shutdown.
927:             if _shutdown_owner == current_thread or (
928:                 _shutdown_worker is not None and _shutdown_worker.is_current()
929:             ):
930:                 return _shutdown_result
931:             completed = _shutdown_condition.wait_for(
932:                 lambda: _shutdown_state == "idle",
933:                 timeout=max(0.0, deadline - time.monotonic()),
934:             )
935:             return _shutdown_result if completed else False
936:         _shutdown_state = "closing"
937:         _shutdown_owner = current_thread
938: 
939:     acquired = _lifecycle_operation_lock.acquire(timeout=max(0.0, deadline - time.monotonic()))
940:     if not acquired:
941:         with _shutdown_condition:
942:             _shutdown_result = False
943:             _shutdown_state = "idle"
944:             _shutdown_owner = None
945:             _shutdown_condition.notify_all()
946:         return False
947:     shutdown_worker = _shutdown_worker
948:     try:
949:         try:
950:             result = _perform_shutdown(
951:                 max(0, int((deadline - time.monotonic()) * 1000)),
952:                 termination_reason,
953:                 synchronous=_synchronous,
954:             )
955:         except BaseException:
956:             with _shutdown_condition:
957:                 _shutdown_result = False
958:             raise
959:         else:
960:             with _shutdown_condition:
961:                 _shutdown_result = result
962:             return result
963:     finally:
964:         if shutdown_worker is not None:
965:             shutdown_worker.close()
966:         if _shutdown_worker is shutdown_worker:
967:             _shutdown_worker = None
968:         _lifecycle_operation_lock.release()
969:         with _shutdown_condition:
970:             _shutdown_state = "idle"
971:             _shutdown_owner = None
972:             _shutdown_condition.notify_all()

976:     timeout_millis: int,
977:     termination_reason: str,
978:     *,

980: ) -> bool:
981:     """End active Neatlogs spans, then flush and shut down SDK providers."""
982:     global _tracer_provider, _owns_tracer_provider, _log_provider, _span_processor, _initialized
983:     global _init_signature
984:     global _instrumentation_manager, _transport_span_processors, _completion_span_processor

988:     try:
989:         atexit.unregister(_atexit_shutdown)
990:     except Exception:
991:         pass

993:     _restore_shutdown_signal_handlers()
994: 
995:     success = True
996:     deadline = time.monotonic() + max(0, timeout_millis) / 1000
997:     log_provider = _log_provider
998:     tracer_provider = _tracer_provider
999:     owns_tracer_provider = _owns_tracer_provider
1000:     span_processor = _span_processor
1001:     completion_span_processor = _completion_span_processor
1002:     transport_span_processors = list(_transport_span_processors)
1003:     instrumentation_manager = _instrumentation_manager

1012:         completion_span_processor.begin_shutdown()
1013:     if span_processor is not None:
1014:         span_processor.begin_shutdown(termination_reason)

1016:     # LOG records must drain before trace completion. The tracer batch contains
1017:     # neatlogs.trace.complete, which can trigger backend finalization as soon as
1018:     # it is ingested.
1019:     if log_provider:
1020:         logger.debug("Shutting down log provider...")
1021:         completed, result = bounded_call(
1022:             log_provider.shutdown,
1023:             deadline,
1024:             synchronous=synchronous,
1025:             worker=shutdown_worker,
1026:         )
1027:         if not completed:
1028:             logger.error("Log provider shutdown failed or timed out: %s", result)
1029:             success = False
1030:         else:
1031:             success = (result is None or bool(result)) and success
1032:             logger.debug("Log provider shut down successfully")

1035:     if span_processor:

1037:             lambda: span_processor.end_active_spans(termination_reason),
1038:             deadline,
1039:             synchronous=synchronous,
1040:             worker=shutdown_worker,
1041:         )
1042:         if completed:
1043:             ended = result
1044:             if ended:
1045:                 logger.info(f"Ended {ended} active Neatlogs span(s) during {termination_reason}")

1047:             logger.warning("Ending active Neatlogs spans failed or timed out: %s", result)
1048:             success = False
1049:         completed, result = bounded_call(
1050:             span_processor._log_performance_stats,
1051:             deadline,
1052:             synchronous=synchronous,
1053:             worker=shutdown_worker,
1054:         )
1055:         if not completed:
1056:             logger.warning("Logging performance stats failed or timed out: %s", result)
1057:             success = False
1058:         remaining_millis = max(0, int((deadline - time.monotonic()) * 1000))

1062:     if completion_span_processor is not None:
1063:         if transport_span_processors:
1064:             completed, result = bounded_call(
1065:                 lambda: transport_span_processors[0].force_flush(
1066:                     timeout_millis=max(0, int((deadline - time.monotonic()) * 1000))
1067:                 ),
1068:                 deadline,
1069:                 synchronous=synchronous,
1070:                 worker=shutdown_worker,
1071:             )
1072:             if not completed or (result is not None and not bool(result)):
1073:                 logger.warning("Pre-completion span flush failed or timed out")
1074:                 success = False
1075:         completed, result = bounded_call(
1076:             completion_span_processor.emit_deferred,
1077:             deadline,
1078:             synchronous=synchronous,
1079:             worker=shutdown_worker,
1080:         )
1081:         if not completed:
1082:             logger.warning("Completion marker emission failed or timed out: %s", result)
1083:             success = False
1084:         if transport_span_processors:
1085:             completed, result = bounded_call(
1086:                 lambda: transport_span_processors[0].force_flush(
1087:                     timeout_millis=max(0, int((deadline - time.monotonic()) * 1000))
1088:                 ),
1089:                 deadline,
1090:                 synchronous=synchronous,
1091:                 worker=shutdown_worker,
1092:             )
1093:             if not completed or (result is not None and not bool(result)):
1094:                 logger.warning("Completion marker flush failed or timed out")

1097:     if tracer_provider:
1098:         if owns_tracer_provider:
1099:             completed, result = bounded_call(
1100:                 tracer_provider.shutdown,
1101:                 deadline,
1102:                 synchronous=synchronous,
1103:                 worker=shutdown_worker,
1104:             )

1107:                 success = (result is None or bool(result)) and success
1108:                 logger.debug("Tracer provider shut down successfully")
1109:             else:
1110:                 logger.error("Tracer provider shutdown failed or timed out: %s", result)
1111:                 success = False
1112:         else:
1113:             completed, result = bounded_call(
1114:                 lambda: tracer_provider.force_flush(
1115:                     timeout_millis=max(0, int((deadline - time.monotonic()) * 1000))
1116:                 ),
1117:                 deadline,
1118:                 synchronous=synchronous,
1119:                 worker=shutdown_worker,
1120:             )
1121:             if completed:
